name: dmitriy-claude-plugins
description: Reusable skills and plugins for AI agents: development workflows, writing, and automation.

plugins.name: seo-pulse
plugins.description: Run Search Console driven SEO cycles and maintain weekly reports and signal issues without editing sites.

plugins.name: unity-dev
plugins.description: Develop and test Unity projects with shared C# guidance and editor discovery scripts.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Develop Python projects with shared architecture, implementation, review, and testing guidance.

plugins.name: typescript-dev
plugins.description: Develop TypeScript projects with shared architecture, implementation, review, and testing guidance.

plugins.name: codex-collaboration
plugins.description: Coordinate Claude-led analysis and Codex validation through shared review and verdict contracts.

plugins.name: implementation-prd
plugins.description: Write implementation-ready product specs with contracts, data models, and test plans.

plugins.name: learning-guide
plugins.description: Build interactive HTML learning guides with embedded sources, quizzes, and navigation.

plugins.name: tg-essentials
plugins.description: Read and manage Telegram chats, send bot alerts, and publish checked deployment announcements.

plugins.name: tg-voice
plugins.description: Transcribe Telegram voice notes locally through a Claude Code download hook.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove common AI writing patterns from English and Russian text using the matching ruleset.

plugins.name: agent-dispatch
plugins.description: Run queued GitHub issues locally through Claude Code or Codex, with scheduled dispatch and recovery.

plugins.name: issue-to-pr
plugins.description: Take GitHub issues to reviewed pull requests through isolated worktrees, tests, and explicit merge gates.

plugins.name: claude-md-slim
plugins.description: Audit and split oversized CLAUDE.md instructions, with checks that preserve their content.
